description: Fourth RuntimeHost reduction slice. Remove a very small, coherent set of zero-reference internal controllers focused on change-impact and compiler preview surfaces.
rationale: The current RuntimeHost footprint still shows a large internalButNeeded controller inventory with many zero-reference dead/remove candidates.
This batch stays conservative by touching controllers only, not more services.
The slice is intentionally thematic and small to reduce risk: change-impact and compiler-preview endpoints only.
